csp-learning-review.en: Review and roll back learned practices

csp-miniapp-runtime.zh: 小程序与小游戏运行验证

csp-vibecoding-batch.zh: 维护既有 Vibecoding 任务包

dsh-session-format-debug.reason_zh: DSH 的会话记录格式和恢复器随宿主变化。
dsh-session-format-debug.reason_en: The DSH session schema and recovery utility depend on that host.

electron-asar-code-forensics.reason_zh: 针对已打包第三方客户端的分析依赖具体版本；本包提供自有工件核验。
electron-asar-code-forensics.reason_en: Inspection of vendor-packaged internals depends on a specific build; this pack covers validation of owned artifacts.

github-accelerator.reason_zh: 依赖特定网络服务和用户配置，不能作为通用默认设置分发。
github-accelerator.reason_en: This depends on a network service and individual routing settings.

hid-device-protocol-probe.reason_zh: 设备协议、硬件与厂商资料均为前置条件，不能用通用软件验收代替。
hid-device-protocol-probe.reason_en: The procedure needs a specific device, its protocol and vendor documentation.

memory-bank-divergence-repair.reason_zh: 该修复器依赖 Qoder 的记忆文件布局。通用交接和经验维护另有技能。
memory-bank-divergence-repair.reason_en: The repair tool assumes the Qoder memory layout; handoff and learning reviews have separate workflows.

mongodb-mcp-setup.reason_zh: 此供应商连接需要自己的服务和授权；本包的 MCP 示例不配置数据库账号。
mongodb-mcp-setup.reason_en: This vendor connection needs a separately provisioned service and authorized credentials; the examples do not configure database accounts.

proxy-rule-surgery.reason_zh: 依赖本机代理客户端和实际路由表，不能跨用户移植规则。
proxy-rule-surgery.reason_en: The changes depend on the installed proxy and its live route table.

shipped-app-js-patch-hygiene.reason_zh: 修改第三方已签名应用的内部代码不属于通用 Codex 发布包。
shipped-app-js-patch-hygiene.reason_en: Modifying the internals of a signed third-party binary is outside this portable pack.
